label: Receiving production
definition: The passing game by who catches it: target distribution and results by roster group (WR, TE, RB), how concentrated the targets are, depth and yards after the catch. Offense, and what each defense faced by receiver group.

garbage_time.policy: Dual-surfaced: `all` counts every snap; `competitive` drops garbage time (play_filters.is_garbage_time).

team.label: Air yards per attempt (aDOT)
team.definition: Air yards to the caught / thrown-to / intercepted spot, charted throws only.

team.label: Yards after catch per completion
team.defense_label: Yards after catch allowed per completion
team.definition: Credited yards (play_yardage.credited_yards) less air yards, completions with a charted spot.

team.label: Share of receiving yards after the catch
team.definition: YAC / credited yards on charted completions.

team.label: Top target's share
team.definition: Targets to the most-targeted receiver / targets to named receivers.

team.label: Top two targets' share
team.definition: Targets to the two most-targeted receivers / targets to named receivers.

team.label: Target concentration (HHI)
team.definition: Herfindahl over named receivers: higher = the ball goes to fewer people.

team.label: Targets to rostered players outside WR/TE/RB
team.definition: Hybrid/ATH players, quarterbacks, linemen -- and receiver names that resolved to a defender on the roster (a name collision; see the receiving notes).

team.label: Targets to an unidentified receiver
team.defense_label: Targets faced to an unidentified receiver
team.definition: Data quality: targets whose receiver name did not resolve to a rostered player. Group shares (WR/TE/RB) are of all targets, so this is the part they cannot place.

team.label: Target share, wide receivers
team.definition: Targets to wide receivers (roster position group) / all targets.

team.label: EPA per target, wide receivers
team.defense_label: EPA per target allowed, wide receivers
team.definition: EPA per target to wide receivers; an incompletion counts.

team.label: Success per target, wide receivers
team.defense_label: Success allowed per target, wide receivers
team.definition: Success rate of targets to wide receivers.

team.label: Catch rate, wide receivers
team.definition: Completions / targets to wide receivers.

team.label: Yards per target, wide receivers
team.defense_label: Yards per target allowed, wide receivers
team.definition: Credited yards on catches / targets to wide receivers.

team.label: 3rd-down target share, wide receivers
team.definition: Share of 3rd-down targets that went to wide receivers.

team.label: Red-zone target share, wide receivers
team.definition: Share of red-zone targets (play_filters.is_red_zone_snap) that went to wide receivers.

team.label: Target share, tight ends
team.definition: Targets to tight ends (roster position group) / all targets.

team.label: EPA per target, tight ends
team.defense_label: EPA per target allowed, tight ends
team.definition: EPA per target to tight ends; an incompletion counts.

team.label: Success per target, tight ends
team.defense_label: Success allowed per target, tight ends
team.definition: Success rate of targets to tight ends.

team.label: Catch rate, tight ends
team.definition: Completions / targets to tight ends.

team.label: Yards per target, tight ends
team.defense_label: Yards per target allowed, tight ends
team.definition: Credited yards on catches / targets to tight ends.

team.label: 3rd-down target share, tight ends
team.definition: Share of 3rd-down targets that went to tight ends.

team.label: Red-zone target share, tight ends
team.definition: Share of red-zone targets (play_filters.is_red_zone_snap) that went to tight ends.

team.label: Target share, running backs
team.definition: Targets to running backs (roster position group) / all targets.

team.label: EPA per target, running backs
team.defense_label: EPA per target allowed, running backs
team.definition: EPA per target to running backs; an incompletion counts.

team.label: Success per target, running backs
team.defense_label: Success allowed per target, running backs
team.definition: Success rate of targets to running backs.

team.label: Catch rate, running backs
team.definition: Completions / targets to running backs.

team.label: Yards per target, running backs
team.defense_label: Yards per target allowed, running backs
team.definition: Credited yards on catches / targets to running backs.

team.label: 3rd-down target share, running backs
team.definition: Share of 3rd-down targets that went to running backs.

team.label: Red-zone target share, running backs
team.definition: Share of red-zone targets (play_filters.is_red_zone_snap) that went to running backs.

players.label: EPA per target
players.definition: EPA per target; an incompletion counts.

players.label: Share of team air yards
players.definition: His air yards (charted targets) / the team's air yards: how much of the downfield passing game runs through him.

player_qualify: sample (targets) >= 2 per team game; ranks are among qualified players only
notes: Completion, yards and EPA by depth x direction (offense and allowed) are published in team-analytics/spatial_{season}.json pass_grid; not counted again here.
Receiver position group comes from the roster (player_seasons position_group). Group shares + other + unidentified = 1.

2026-10-27 data finding: some targets resolve to rostered defenders (Southern's Jayden Cook, LB, 9 targets; others with 1-3). Either two-way players or roster-lookup name collisions; reported, not rewritten.
